decisions.question: Which app stores are being targeted?

branches.then: Generate iPhone (and optionally iPad) screenshots only
Generate Android phone, tablet, and Feature Graphic as needed
Use platform-based directory structure (apple/ + android/) and generate all required device sizes

decisions.fallback: Default to iPhone-only structure until confirmed otherwise

decisions.question: Are screenshots needed in multiple languages?

branches.then: Add locale subdirectories and mirror RTL layout for ar/he/fa/ur locales

decisions.fallback: Omit locale folder; use flat screenshot paths

interactions.prompt: Before writing any code, I need to ask you several questions: (1) app screenshot file paths, (2) app icon path, (3) brand colors, (4) font preference, (5) feature list in priority order, (6) desired slide count, (7) visual style direction.
